name: Are there financial assistance programs for foundation retrofits in California?

mainEntity.name: Are there financial assistance programs for foundation retrofits in California?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, California homeowners may be eligible for financial assistance programs. The California Earthquake Authority (CEA) offers the Earthquake Brace + Bolt (EBB) program, which provides grants to homeowners in eligible ZIP Codes to offset the cost of foundation retrofits. These grants can cover a significant portion of the retrofit expenses. Eligibility typically depends on your home's characteristics and location. It is advisable to check the EBB website or consult with a qualified contractor for current program availability and requirements.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, programs like the California Earthquake Authority's Earthquake Brace + Bolt (EBB) offer grants for eligible homeowners to help cover retrofit costs.
